SECOND AMENDMENT 
 
 to the Loan Agreement dated 4 April 2019 as amended vide the Amendment dated 3 April 2020 (“Loan Agreement”) , by and between 
 
 Zameen Venture One (Private) Limited (“ Lender ”) and Zameen Arcs (Private) Limited (“ Borrower ”) 
 
 This Second Amendment (“ Second Amendment ”) to the Loan Agreement , is made and entered into at Lahore on this ______________________ (“ Effective Date ”), by and between the Parties. 
 
 NOW, THEREFORE, the Parties agree as follows: 
 
 The Second Amendment shall be effective from the Effective Date. 
 
 The Termination Date , as referred in Clause 2 of the Loan Agreement , shall be extended to 30 June 2024 . 
 
 This Second Amendment shall be read as an integral part of the Loan Agreement. 
 
 All other terms and provisions in the Loan Agreement shall apply mutatis mutandis and shall continue in full force and effect in accordance with the terms mentioned therein. In the event of any conflict, the provisions of this Second Amendment shall prevail and any conflicting term in the Loan Agreement shall be deemed amended appropriately. 
 
 All expressions and terms defined or used in the Loan Agreement shall bear the same meaning in this Second Amendment, unless otherwise specified.
